description: Local WAN adapter catalog entry: WAN CS.

compatibility.notes: Local source naming identifies WAN 2.2 I2V, and 5120-wide adapter tensors support the 14B layout. The file has no architecture or expert metadata and its filename does not identify high/low noise, so expert_target is null. Strength 1.0 uses the local recommendation of at least 1.0. The repeated leading example token is stored as a trigger; full prompt examples remain in notes_file. The referenced 4-6-step wrapper workflow is not assumed to be a preset for the current base-model workflow. Checkpoint compatibility has not been tested. Metadata was populated from local notes and weight headers.
